text:
marta: heads-up  onboarding lyra-mini-4b (hf -> redwood int4) hit a nasty regression on summarization suite. small prompts fine, multi-sentence summary quality tanks.
jon: numbers? quick diff pls
marta: Rouge-L fp16 41.2 -> int4 24.9, top1 token swap rate ~36% for certain prefixes.
sandeep: that smells like head interleave + rotary scaling mismatch. some checkpoints export heads interleaved in even/odd pairs; converters often assume contiguous head blocks.
jon: try forcing proj_order and head_layout flags. we added `--proj_layout=even_odd` recently for a few oddball exports.
marta: repro cmd I used: 
```
python tools/convert_model.py \
  --src=hf --dst=redwood \
  --model=lyra-mini-4b \
  --quant=int4 --proj_layout=auto
```
marta: eval snippet: 
```
[eval] rouge-l: 24.9 (fp16 41.2)
[token_swap] 0.36
```
sandeep: another vector: check for `rotary_scale` or `rotary_alpha` legacy tensors. if per-head alpha != 1.0 we need to apply it when building sin/cos tables — otherwise angles alias at longer contexts.
jon: ran a small probe here: scanning proj_layout candidates (contiguous, interleaved, even_odd) and rotary alpha in [1.0,0.9,0.75] on a 20-sample microbench. best combo was proj_layout=even_odd + rotary_alpha=0.9 -> rouge-l 40.3.
marta: confirmed locally: even_odd + alpha=0.9 recovers most of the gap: rouge-l 40.8. also fixed the top1 swap.
jon: interestingly, tokenizer mismatch also bit us. lyra's vocab uses a capitalized ligature token AB (two-char custom) that HF fast normalizer lowercases in some configs. when client sends requests with different tokenizer_mode, KV-cache offsets drift.
sandeep: mitigation plan: (1) update convert to honor `rotary_alpha*` tensors and store per-head alpha in artifact metadata; (2) add proj_layout autodetect that tries small candidate set and picks best ppl/rouge on microbench; (3) add tokenizer normalizer step and emit `tokenizer_mode` + `tokenizer_hash`; (4) add unit that runs a 10-sample cross-check against fp16 and asserts token_swap_rate < 5%.
marta: created RED-1105 with repro script and short logs. will open PR with autodetect + metadata keys. target: PR by EOD.
bot-onboard: issue RED-1105 created: "lyra-mini-4b int4 proj_layout + rotary_alpha + tokenizer-mode" (severity: medium)
jon: one more thing: include `head_mapping` in metadata (e.g., "even_odd" or a permutation array) so Console can show what conversion used and warn if client tokenizer_hash mismatches.
sandeep: agreed. also recommend running a nightly 6-benchmark job for all models converted to int4 to catch these early.
marta: thanks  will attach mini-bench logs and the failing prompt set to the ticket and ping for review.
jon: I'll queue an overnight cluster run for the full eval once PR lands.
